import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'gamma': 0.99}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.corr = nn.Linear(64, spec.n_actions)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.corr.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.corr.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + self.corr(g)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):

            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)

        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.sproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, SP, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Linear(SP * spec.Y * spec.X + 64, spec.n_actions)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dense.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dense.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        sp = F.relu(self.sproj(f)).flatten(1)
        corr = self.dense(torch.cat([sp, g], dim=1))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'lr': 0.002, 'n_envs': 512, 'rollout_len': 16, 'n_minibatches': 16, 'ppo_epochs': 1, 'ent_coef': 0.02, 'gamma': 0.995, 'gae_lambda': 0.97, 'clip_eps': 0.2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
CW = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.pn = nn.GroupNorm(4, proj)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.pn(self.proj(f))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Critic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.a = nn.Conv2d(cin, CW, 1)
        self.na = nn.GroupNorm(4, CW)
        self.b = nn.Conv2d(CW, CW, 3, padding=1)
        self.nb = nn.GroupNorm(4, CW)
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(2 * CW), nn.Linear(2 * CW, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))

    def forward(self, obs):
        h = F.relu(self.na(self.a(obs)))
        h = F.relu(h + self.nb(self.b(h)))
        g = torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        return self.mlp(g).squeeze(1)


class Net(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.GroupNorm(4, STEM), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.GroupNorm(4, COL), nn.ReLU())

        self.n1 = nn.GroupNorm(4, WIDTH)

        self.n2 = nn.GroupNorm(4, WIDTH)

        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(2 * WIDTH), nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())

        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.critic(obs)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'ent_coef': 0.02, 'gamma': 0.97}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DP = 16


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.dpath = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, DP, 1)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64 + 2 * DP, 1)
        nn.init.normal_(self.done_head.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.constant_(self.done_head.bias, -4.0)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        d = F.relu(self.dpath(obs))
        dg = torch.cat([g, d.amax((2, 3)), d.mean((2, 3))], dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(dg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, C1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(C1, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(W, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 32), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(32, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(32, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = self.col(obs)
        f = F.relu(c + self.c1(c))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {'lr': 0.002, 'n_envs': 256, 'rollout_len': 16, 'n_minibatches': 16, 'ppo_epochs': 2, 'ent_coef': 0.005, 'gamma': 0.97, 'gae_lambda': 0.92, 'clip_eps': 0.2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
HID = 32


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(c, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, out in zip(self.fps, self.convs, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(f, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(conv(q))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + 2, STEM, 1), nn.GroupNorm(4, STEM), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.GroupNorm(4, COL), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.n1 = nn.GroupNorm(4, WIDTH)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=2, dilation=2)
        self.n2 = nn.GroupNorm(4, WIDTH)
        self.ctx = nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.head = FootHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(2 * WIDTH), nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(64, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 1))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, yy, xx], dim=1)
        s = self.stem(inp)
        x = F.relu(self.n1(self.c1(s)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.n2(self.c2(x)))
        pooled = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        f2 = F.relu(f + self.ctx(pooled)[:, :, None, None])
        place = self.head(f2)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: Generation 0 ran 84 trials across many architectures and recipes, and every one scored exactly 0 on dev and in training, on both seeds. Normal seed luck would almost never give that. It points either to a quirk in this world or to the agent hardly learning within the budget. One possible quirk is that action indices, or the DONE index, are laid out differently from the spec. If the agent can never press DONE, every structured head would score 0, while fully dense heads would learn too slowly to show anything. I therefore keep the starting structured head as a prior and add residual per-action corrections, initialised at zero, that can learn any index-specific behaviour. Two levels are tested: corrections from global features only, and corrections that also see flattened spatial features. The third candidate tests recipe settings never tried before: lr 3e-3, gae_lambda 0.8 and minibatches of 256 samples. Any nonzero score would be informative.
analyses.2: Every trial in generation 0 and round 1 scored 0.000, including training success. That covers recipe changes (lr up to 3e-3, gae_lambda 0.8, 64 envs), corrections to the action layout (a zero-initialised correction for every action, a dense head) and many network families. With every score at zero, seed noise can't be measured. The failure happens across architectures, which points to something common to all of them. Candidates: (1) the observation or reward scale is not as described, so activations or value loss swamp the global gradient-norm clip and the policy barely moves; none of the networks tried used normalisation layers; (2) the reward signal is sparser or later than described, which needs longer credit assignment (gamma 0.995 and gae_lambda 0.97 have never been tried) and more samples per update (n_envs 512 has never been tried). This round tests (1) and (2) separately and then together, so that a nonzero result can be traced to its cause.
analyses.3: After 90 trials (84 in generation 0 and 6 here), every one has scored 0 on both seeds, in dev and in training. There is still no seed-noise estimate and no way to rank ideas. Nothing points to a specific cause. Normalisation, separate critics, dense or per-action correction heads, long horizons, large batches and high learning rates all failed. If the world's quirk scrambled the action layout or the observation scale, the dense corrections or normalisation should have helped. They did not. That points to a systemic learning failure: a policy collapse, credit assignment, or a reward unlike the description, which no network can fix. Two causes have not been tested. One is early collapse onto DONE: random placements mostly earn negative reward, while DONE earns 0. The other is rollouts cut off before episodes end. Tiny networks are also untested. I expect these candidates may well score 0 too.
analyses.4: All 9 trials in this search scored 0.000 on both seeds, in both training and dev. Generation 0 also scored 0 in 84 trials. These changes all left training success at zero: zero-initialised correction layers that can remap any action index, normalisation, a separate critic, DONE suppression, whole-episode rollouts, a tiny network, high lr, low lambda, 512 envs and gamma 0.995. With nothing above zero, seed noise is still unknown. The evidence points to a learning failure and not to a mismatch in the action layout: even heads that can remap every action index failed. Nothing has ranked one idea above another. In this last round I make three different bets. Two are recipe regions not yet tried: many small single-epoch updates on the normalised net, and 1024 envs. The third is a new head that learns a convolution over each brick's footprint, with coordinate channels and global context added to every cell. Its recipe is moderate, with low entropy.
